subject: Intro: NovaCore x Redwood demo (referred by EdgeBridge)
messages:
From: Alex Johansen <alex@edgebridge.io>

Cc: partner-success@edgebridge.io
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: NovaCore x Redwood (warm referral)

Hi Laura / Vivek —

Quick intro: I work with NovaCore on integrations (they're evaluating inference options for their analytics product). They completed a trial last week and asked for a walkthrough focused on throughput and private deployment options. I copied Priya Singh (head of platform at NovaCore) so you can coordinate directly.

Why I think Redwood fits: NovaCore needs predictable latency under bursty traffic and clear guidance around Dedicated vs. Private for compliance. We also discussed cost/throughput tradeoffs.

Attaching a brief referral note with the customer's goals + trial usage snapshot.

Attachment: EdgeBridge-Referral-Note.pdf (1 page)

Alex
Lead Partnerships, EdgeBridge
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johansen <alex@edgebridge.io>, Priya Singh <priya@novacore.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: NovaCore x Redwood (warm referral)

Hi Alex — thanks for the intro and the referral note, very helpful.

Hi Priya — great to meet you by email. Welcome and congrats on getting some trial runs in. We'd love to run a short 30–45 minute demo tailored to your goals: throughput under burst, deployment options (Dedicated vs Private), and cost per inference.

Proposed times (PST):
- Mon, Aug 31 — 10:00–10:45am
- Tue, Sep 1 — 11:30–12:15pm
- Wed, Sep 2 — 2:00–2:45pm

If none of those work, tell us a couple of windows that do. Also, could you share the top 2 technical questions you'd like covered (e.g., KV cache behavior, autoscaling config, quantization impact)? That will help Vivek hit the highest value items.

I'll include a calendar invite and a short pre-demo questionnaire once we lock a slot.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Priya Singh <priya@novacore.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro: NovaCore x Redwood (warm referral)

Thanks Alex — appreciate the intro. Hi Laura / Vivek, nice to meet you both.

We ran a short self-serve evaluation last week and found good accuracy, but our concerns are around:
1) Sustaining 1000 concurrent requests with p50 < 200ms (we're in us-west),
2) Data isolation and key management for customer embeddings,
3) Deployment options for SOC2-compliant setups.

The Tue, Sep 1 window at 11:30am PST works best for our team (me and our platform lead, Sameer). If possible, please include any notes about estimated cost at that throughput level — a back-of-envelope is fine.

Also, we have a short security questionnaire we'll want to review; if you can send the SOC2 evidence pointers in the calendar invite or a drive link that'd be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward.
Priya Singh
Head of Platform, NovaCore
priya@novacore.ai | +1 (650) 555-0246

- 5 min intros and goals

- 10 min Q&A (security + cost estimate)

Attachments: redwood-demo-novacore.ics (calendar invite)

See you on Sep 1.
